assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskites became a new photovoltaic absorber class within a decade, with certified efficiencies rivaling silicon and a very large structure-property literature (defect tolerance, tunable bandgap, compositional engineering). It is a materials discovery whose designed crystal architecture gives a new function with real application, which is the profile I value most.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first used perovskites as sensitizers (2009), Park and co-workers made the solid-state cell that showed stability and efficiency (2012), and Snaith showed the meso-superstructured and planar-heterojunction architectures. Gratzel, Seok and Kanatzidis made major contributions too, so a three-person limit forces a contested choice. Kojima is not on the credited list, which is an attribution gap I cannot repair.
assessment.maturity: Efficiency gains are independently reproduced worldwide and tandem and module work is advancing. Long-term operational stability, lead content and commercial scale-up are still unresolved, so the timing is arguable but defensible.
uncertainties: Operational stability and toxicity may weaken the claim of lasting practical impact.
Priority and credit among the early sensitizer, solid-state and thin-film architecture papers is disputed, and my recollection of exact dates is imperfect.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced-proximity degradation reframed drug discovery by turning ubiquitin ligases into programmable tools and explained the mechanism of thalidomide-type drugs. It has produced a new chemical modality now in many clinical programs, so the concept is original, general and already consequential.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies established the heterobifunctional PROTAC concept and its use in cells, and Handa's group identified cereblon as the thalidomide target that underlies molecular-glue degraders. Ciulli, Gray and others made decisive structural and chemical contributions, so credit is spread out and the choice is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Cocrystal structures of ternary complexes and clinical-stage degraders give strong confirmation, but no degrader has yet been approved, so the field is still young and recognition may come slightly early.
uncertainties: Whether an approved PROTAC will exist soon enough to strengthen the case.
Credit split between the PROTAC concept, the cereblon mechanism and the molecular-glue work is unresolved.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Serial femtosecond crystallography extended structure determination to nanocrystals and made time-resolved structures of reactions possible at room temperature, beyond radiation damage limits. It is an enabling structural method for a whole community, which fits my own background in structure determination from tiny crystals.
assessment.attribution: Chapman led the 2011 proof of principle and the data-processing foundations, Fromme worked on photosystem I nanocrystals and sample strategy, and Hajdu developed the diffract-before-destroy concept. Schlichting, Spence and others also contributed decisively, so the three-person choice omits important people.
assessment.maturity: Results are confirmed at several XFEL facilities, with reproducible structures and time-resolved studies. Its impact on chemistry is so far narrower than on structural biology, and the facilities are few.
uncertainties: Whether the committee would see this as chemistry or as physics and biology.
Conceptual priority between the diffract-before-destroy idea and the experimental demonstration is debated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rational design of zeolites and related molecular sieves, using organic structure-directing agents, new frameworks and engineered active sites, underlies refining, emissions control and fine chemistry. The structure-to-function story is clear, and the practical impact is very large.
assessment.attribution: Corma contributed catalytic design and new frameworks, Davis made extra-large-pore and framework-design contributions, and Zones developed structure-directing strategies, notably the Chevron work. Yu, Tsapatsis and others are also credited, and the discovery is diffuse, so a compact prize configuration is hard to defend.
assessment.maturity: Maturity is very high, with decades of industrial use and many structures solved. The danger is that the topic is cumulative and fragmented rather than a single decisive discovery.
uncertainties: Whether a single, clearly bounded discovery exists within this broad field.
Roles of the different groups in structure-directing agent design are hard to separate from the supplied credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The nitrogenase structures, including the discovery of the central carbide in the iron-molybdenum cofactor, link atomic structure to biological nitrogen fixation, one of chemistry's central problems. The structural evidence is strong and the questions it raises about the mechanism are fundamental.
assessment.attribution: Rees established the first crystal structures and cofactor environment, Einsle resolved the interstitial carbide at high resolution, and Seefeldt together with Dean developed the mechanistic framework. Ribbe and Dean also contributed, so allocation is uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Structures are reproducible, but the catalytic mechanism, including how substrate binds and dinitrogen is reduced, is still not fully established. Recent cryo-EM turnover states are promising but not yet final.
uncertainties: The mechanism of N2 reduction is still debated, so the claim may be premature.
Credit between structural biology and mechanistic enzymology groups is unresolved.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat's tethering approach to the mutant cysteine of KRAS G12C turned a target long considered undruggable into a drug target, leading to approved covalent inhibitors. The chemical-genetic analog-sensitive kinase work added a general tool. The structural basis (the switch-II pocket) is well documented.
assessment.attribution: The central discovery is attributable to one person with his group, and the supplied credit lists only him, which gives a clean one-person configuration. Industry developers built the approved drugs but the key chemical insight is his.
assessment.maturity: Clinical approvals and independent crystal structures give strong confirmation. Resistance mechanisms are a limitation on durability but do not undermine the discovery.
uncertainties: Whether the committee prefers a broader chemical-biology prize that shares credit with other covalent-ligand discovery work.
Resistance to KRAS G12C inhibitors may reduce the case for long-term impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: MXenes are a large family of two-dimensional carbides and nitrides, produced by selective etching of MAX phases, with tunable composition, surface chemistry and properties in energy storage, electromagnetic shielding and catalysis. This is a new materials family with designed structure and function, directly in my area.
assessment.attribution: Naguib, Gogotsi and Barsoum published the first Ti3C2 MXene in 2011, with Barsoum's MAX-phase work as the foundation. The three-person credit looks natural and relatively clean, although other groups have extended the family greatly.
assessment.maturity: Reproduction across many laboratories is strong, but the applications are still maturing and stability, oxidation and reproducible synthesis remain concerns. Recognition may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: Real-world application impact is not yet demonstrated at scale.
Surface terminations and structures are hard to define, which weakens structural certainty for many compositions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Single-atom catalysts connect precise atomic structure to catalytic function and have reshaped thinking in heterogeneous catalysis and electrocatalysis. The concept is influential and the structural characterization (aberration-corrected STEM, X-ray absorption) is a central part of the story.
assessment.attribution: The Zhang and Qiao 2011 report named and established the field, with Liu contributing early imaging and the concept of single-atom catalysis. Datye, Wang and Li also contributed. Credit is plausible but contestable for a field that grew quickly.
assessment.maturity: Confirmation is widespread but I am concerned about rigor: many claims of isolated single sites rest on limited averaged or local evidence, and stability under reaction conditions is often uncertain. Recognition may be premature.
uncertainties: Quality of structural evidence varies considerably across the literature.
Whether single atoms are the true active species under working conditions is often unresolved.
